purpose: Manual same-task skill comparison; prompts are fictional and contain no private corpus.

cases.prompt: Design a tenant-aware internal helpdesk RAG service. Team A and Team B documents share one search index. A grant can be revoked while an answer is being generated. The corpus owner and provider permission are not yet confirmed. State the smallest safe implementation and acceptance evidence.
requiredSignals: corpus owner and provider authority remain unconfirmed
per-source ACL and tenant checks before model context
final publication authorization and zero-output revocation case

cases.prompt: A reindex worker staged half of document revision 2, crashed, then revision 3 deleted the document. The old worker retries, and an operator wants to roll back the index to yesterday. Give an implementation and a deterministic fault test.
requiredSignals: staged manifest and atomic active snapshot
rollback still enforces current source authority
assert no partial, duplicate or resurrected content
forbiddenClaims: old snapshot may restore deleted content
index outage simulation proves replay safety

cases.prompt: A RAG prototype has three example questions and only a local synthetic ACL fixture. The team claims its answer quality and citations are production ready. Design a baseline/candidate evaluation and state exactly what can be reported now.
requiredSignals: versioned case set and same oracle for both versions
separate retrieval, grounding, citation, access, freshness, latency and cost results
forged citation and unsupported claim cases
synthetic evidence distinguished from model/provider execution
